title: A hand-set Network can add client websites at no charge (LIVE-1232)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: The Group is not paying for a Network subscription, so it must still be able to resell websites (ADR-1816).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. A Network plan with no Stripe subscription behind it and no recorded cash deal (the admin Plan panel is the only way to get one: a cancelled subscription drops a Space to free) is a Network Frequency set up by hand, such as The Group (owner @frequency). Its owner can add, hand off, un-badge and remove client websites, and nothing is billed because there is no bill: syncClientSiteBilling returns ok for it, the Client websites page says there is no charge and hides the bill, and every owner action goes through canManageClientSites (a subscribed Network, billed, or a hand-set one, not billed). A Network with a subscription or a manual cash agreement behaves exactly as before.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/client-site-billing.ts','utf8');const a=fs.readFileSync('lib/collective/client-sites-actions.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!b.includes('async function isCompedNetwork')||!b.includes('stripe_subscription_id'))bad.push('no hand-set Network rule');if(!b.includes('activeAgreementForSpace'))bad.push('a cash-deal Network would be treated as free');if((a.match(/canManageClientSites/g)||[]).length<4)bad.push('an owner action skips the shared gate');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1232: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the hand-set Network rule loses its cash-deal exclusion or an owner action skips the shared gate.
